notes:
Lead: VP Product (Claire Jensen). Mid-market B2B SaaS (marketplace for developer tools). Currently running a small PoC on Redwood Hosted API (embeddings + semantic search) against a 50k-doc catalog. Key asks: cost at scale, vector DB integration patterns, nightly batch/embed pipeline, and predictable tail-latency.

Recent call highlights: 
- 2026-02-11 discovery call (Claire + Eng lead): interested in hosted to move quickly. Quote: 'speed to market matters — but we can't swallow variable cost at 10x usage.'
- 2026-02-25 demo: Ran sample semantic search (top-k) + similarity ranking. Liked streaming and structured output hooks. Noted spike in token usage during reranks.
- 2026-03-01 security review kickoff with infra/security team. Asked about SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, audit log retention and EU data residency.
- 2026-03-03 POC request: run Dedicated-style POC for throughput benchmarks (expected steady-state 200 qps query load for embeddings lookups, peak 600 qps burst) and nightly batch embedding of ~100k new docs.

Technical requirements / preferences: 
- Embedding throughput: want to embed 100k docs overnight (3-6 hour window) — looking for batching recommendations and cost estimates.
- Semantic search latency target: 50-150ms p95 for top-10 retrieval in production.
- Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone (tested) vs open-source Milvus/Weaviate. Need examples of integrating Redwood embeddings + vector DB for hybrid filtering + metadata faceting.
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated open models; want fallback routing to cheaper quantized variants for non-interactive batch runs.
- Data controls: must support SSO/SAML, per-request audit logs, support for customer-managed KMS in Dedicated/Private.

Commercial/ops: 
- Budget: conservative. Est ARR target for this project mid-range $50k-150k. Will prefer committed Dedicated capacity if unit economics beat Hosted after scaling.
- POC scope: 4 weeks. Phase 1 (hosted) completed. Phase 2 (dedicated POC) requested: 2-week benchmark (throughput + tail-latency + cost calc) + nightly batch job demo + integration pattern doc.

Stated concerns: "cold-start latency with Dedicated nodes during low traffic windows"; "how transparent are token-level costs for reranking pipelines".

Rep notes: subtle preference toward vendors that show clear per-route costing and per-token breakdown in consoles. Want to avoid building custom autoscaling logic if Redwood Dedicated autoscaling handles burst to 600 qps.
